locked: Another git is busy in this repository (it holds .git/index.lock). Try again when it is done; Haunt leaves the lock alone.
filtered: {path} goes through a filter ({value}): take the whole file.
filteredUntrusted: {path} goes through a filter ({value}), which runs only in a trusted folder. Trust this folder to write it.
newFileLines: Lines of a new file cannot be picked: take the whole file.
linesGone: None of those lines is a change any more.
nothingToAmend: There is no commit to amend yet.
tookTooLong: git {command} took longer than {minutes} minutes and was stopped.
